name: Cloak of Arachnida

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Web
powers.text: Once per dawn, cast Web (save DC 13), up to twice the normal area.

summary: Resistance to Poison, climb like a spider, webs can't hold you, and a daily Web.
text: This fine garment is made of black silk interwoven with faint silvery threads. While wearing it, you gain the following benefits: you have Resistance to Poison damage; you have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed; you can move up, down and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free; you can't be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were Difficult Terrain; and you can cast Web (save DC 13). The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area. Once used, this property of the cloak can't be used again until the next dawn.
